risks.risk: The listing may not actually include the PS4 console ('PS4 big') or may be missing key parts (console/power/HDMI). Photos do not show the console or accessories.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo/video showing the actual PS4 console (front + back ports), power cable, HDMI cable, and both controllers together.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: PS4 not confirmed/parts not confirmed (use the lowest comparable as a 'hacked/working' PS4 only if you can confirm it works; otherwise treat as not working/partial and negotiate down accordingly).

risks.risk: Controllers/pads may be missing, not original, or not working (sticks/buttons).
risks.proof: Clip showing both controllers connected to the console with button/stick test (or gameplay) and charging/charging indicator if applicable.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: 1 or both pads not guaranteed working.

risks.risk: Games count and titles may be different from '7 games'.
risks.proof: Photo of all 7 game discs/cases laid out with titles visible (or a video scrolling the game library if digital).
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: fewer games than claimed (use the lowest comparable that matches only a console + controller).

risks.risk: Console condition may be poor (overheating, loud fan, storage issues) even if it powers on.
risks.proof: Video of the console booting and running a game for 10–15 minutes with no shutdown/overheating message.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: not fully reliable (assume standard used condition without proof of stability).

proof_requests: Send a photo/video of the actual PS4 (front and back ports) plus the power cable and HDMI cable.
Show both controllers (pads) clearly and confirm they connect (include a quick button/stick test).
Show all 7 games laid out with titles visible (or show the full game list on the console).
Provide a short gameplay/boot clip proving it runs (no crashes) for at least 10 minutes.
